_metadata.description: OT-P2-002 — re-point existing plan-logic consumers to delegate to plan-manager.

requirements.title: Existing consumers delegate plan logic to plan-manager
requirements.description: After plan-manager is proven standalone, re-point existing consumers — swarm-manager phased-plan-drain and project hygiene plan-location checks — to delegate to plan-manager as the plan-logic SSOT, so plan logic stops being duplicated and trapped. Root vrooli plans is retired in favor of direct plan-manager usage. Done in follow-on phases, not the initial build.

validation.notes: Inversion is sequenced after standalone proof; each consumer migration is its own gated change. Tracked here for traceability.
